main.description: Authorize syncing a space, returning a new credential for reading data across it and the space's current revision, and optionally registering for notifications of updates to it. Depending on the space's policy, a delegation token and/or client attestation may be required. Implemented by the space host.

credentialKey.description: P-256 did:key that the credential is bound to.

notify.description: Register an endpoint to be notified of updates to the space via notifySpaceUpdate. The registration stays active while this credential is valid. After it expires, the endpoint receives only a prompt to reauthorize, or notice of the space's deletion.

spaceRev.description: The space's current revision. Omitted before the space's first update.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: May also be returned in place of AccountNotAuthorized, to avoid revealing that the space exists.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: Generic refusal. May be returned in place of AccountNotAuthorized or AppNotAuthorized.

errors.name: RegistrationNotConfirmed
errors.description: The notify endpoint did not confirm the registration.

errors.name: RepoTakendown
errors.description: The space authority has been taken down.

errors.name: RepoDeactivated
errors.description: The space authority has been deactivated.

endpoint.description: Base HTTPS URL that notification methods are called against.

token.description: Opaque secret, included in the body of each request to the endpoint. The endpoint and token together identify the registration, so the token should stay the same across authorizations.
